policy.rule: Any material repair, audit, hardening, provenance correction, data-quality change, or evolution performed through MCP must also be surfaced inside the ICARUS trading interface with repository, branch, exact commit, verification state, interface effect, and execution-authority boundary.
policy.runtime_receipts: Authenticated MCP writes are idempotent by semantic event hash and cannot change trading authority.

checklist.title: Standard timeframe coverage
checklist.detail: 20-minute evidence is verified; standard 1m, 5m, 60m, 240m and daily exports remain outside the verified packet.

checklist.title: HA signal chart with Standard-bars execution-price evidence
checklist.detail: Still requires explicit TradingView Standard bars execution-price proof plus separate trade-list/summary/settings evidence.

checklist.title: RTH / ETH session evidence
checklist.detail: The chat audit classified 2019-start exports as RTH and 2024-start exports as ETH and accepted the screenshots plus normal/Nov-28-2025 shortened-session evidence; an earlier durable intake README was more conservative, so the interface preserves that discrepancy instead of flattening it.

checklist.title: Private originals + SHA-256 provenance
checklist.detail: A reproducible checksum/provenance manifest exists and raw licensed files stay outside GitHub; strict owner-local checksum completion was waived/trusted in the chat path.

checklist.title: Inventory existing corpus before bulk re-export
checklist.detail: Bulk re-export was replaced by corpus recovery/inventory plus representation-aware ingestion. The three end-of-chat hardening blockers were subsequently repaired in NEXUS and are shown below with exact commits.

repairs.summary: Representation claims distinguish chart family from sampling construction and preserve unresolved identity rather than silently collapsing it.
Heikin-Ashi versus standard OHLC identity is separately proven where available; unresolved identity remains non-authoritative.
Fusion balances representation families before cross-asset weighting so dense chart/timeframe families cannot manufacture extra evidence weight.
CSV/source-time ingestion now rejects backward source timestamps before replay, including the generic numeric source-time path.
Ablation paths preserve the original component-weight cap and now have a dedicated regression test.
Historical factor fitting, synthetic factor state, topology estimation, and unfitted latent state preserve missingness instead of treating missing observations as zero.
Reviewed representation authority is bound to exact raw bytes and requires coherent chart-view family, price geometry, sampling domain, and sampling construction before entering the model plane.

Quality telemetry is bound to canonical stream identity, aggregate metrics must agree with per-stream state, and unspecified explicit quality weights contribute zero rather than silently defaulting to full weight.
Research-run manifests validate semantic identity beyond outer hashes, and replay checkpoints refuse invalid state and save atomically.

events.summary: Backward source timestamps are rejected across CSV ingestion paths, including generic numeric source time.
events.verification: Implementation and all-CSV-reader regressions were located and cross-checked by commit history.
events.interface_effect: The prior backward-timestamp blocker is shown as repaired rather than stale/blocked.

events.summary: Ablation runs preserve the component-weight cap and are protected by a dedicated regression.
events.verification: Implementation and regression commits were located during the continuation audit.
events.interface_effect: The prior ablation-cap blocker is shown as repaired with exact source commits.

events.summary: Synthetic-factor and historical factor paths preserve missingness; missing observations are no longer fitted or represented as zero evidence.
events.verification: Synthetic-factor, historical-fit, topology, and latent-state missingness repairs and regressions were located in repository history.
events.interface_effect: The prior missing-data leakage blocker is shown as repaired while preserving provenance to all contributing commits.

events.summary: Reviewed model identity is exact-byte bound and fail-closed across four orthogonal axes: chart family, price geometry, sampling domain, and sampling construction.
events.verification: Implementation commits were inspected through MCP; paired tests cover exact-byte authority, model-plane bridging, sampling-domain identity, and contradictory-axis rejection.
events.interface_effect: The Data Integrity panel exposes this representation-authority hardening as part of O14 provenance.

events.summary: Quality telemetry is now identity-bound and self-consistent; explicit but unspecified quality weights contribute no evidence, and malformed/coerced integrity counters fail closed.
events.verification: MCP diff inspection confirmed stream-id binding, aggregate consistency checks, zero-weight default for omitted explicit weights, and strict integrity metadata counters; dedicated regressions accompany each hardening.
events.interface_effect: The Data Integrity panel exposes the stricter quality-plane contract instead of leaving it only in NEXUS repository history.

events.summary: Research-run genealogy is semantically validated beyond outer hashes, and replay checkpoints reject invalid state before atomic persistence.
events.verification: MCP diff inspection confirmed semantic run-manifest verification and fsync/replace checkpoint persistence; dedicated tamper and atomic-persistence tests were found.
